notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve sign-up. Team: 12 product/ops, building a conversational editor for marketing teams. Quick summary of convo:
- They signed up and ran initial traffic from EU (Amsterdam) but saw 300-600ms p50->p95 spikes for short chat turns; some requests hit SDK timeout (default 30s) during larger multi-turn prompts.
- Quote from PM: "Responses feel sluggish for live demo — client demo failed yesterday because of a timeout."
- Primary goals: fast interactive chat for authors (target p95 < 300ms), affordable per-token cost, easy region routing so EU & NA users see local latency.
- Current setup: self-serve keys, using default region (us-west) from signup flow, single smaller prompt per request but sometimes they batch multiple contextual docs into one prompt (longer tokens).
- They are cost sensitive (SMB budget), prefer hosted API (no infra), want guidance before committing to higher usage.
- Security: want SSO later, basic audit logs now. No enterprise contract yet.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-03-02: Intro call (30m) — demo of their editor; collected p95 latency screenshots from their dev console (attached in Drive). Action: send perf tuning checklist (Daniel).
- 2026-03-04: Customer raised ticket INF-4021 — SDK timeout failures for ~2% of calls under demo load. Support asked for request/response ids.
- 2026-03-06: Email thread with sample requests (thread-CAJ12...) showing prompts that are ~1200 tokens (context + user message).
- 2026-03-09: SE (Daniel) did quick repro from eu-west region and measured p95 ~420ms for identical short prompts; noted increased latency when prompt length >800 tokens.

Use-case + requirements (short):
- Workload: interactive chat for marketing copy + on-demand summarization of uploaded docs. Occasional embeddings for search but low volume.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 300ms for common short-turns (40–150 tokens). Will tolerate higher for long-context summarization.
- Throughput: bursts up to 30 concurrent users during demos; steady-state ~5–10 concurrent.
- Cost sensitivity: tight. Wants recommendations to reduce token usage and batching impact.
- Model preference: flexible; open to smaller fast variants for short-turns, larger for heavy summarization. Wants automatic fallback when dedicated model capacity unavailable.
- Routing: needs a simple region selection (eu-west vs us-east) for keys or API param; interested in guidance on latency vs cost tradeoffs.

Perf tuning suggestions given in call (notes to include in follow-up doc):
- Region choice: suggest using eu-west for EU-heavy traffic — demo showed ~150–220ms improvement in p95 when routed to eu region for short prompts. Recommend explicit region param in requests or separate keys per region for now.
- Timeout settings: recommend raising client SDK timeout to 60s for initial rollout, and implement streaming responses for long completions to avoid hard timeouts.
- Prompt-length guidance: prune context, move large docs to embeddings + retrieval; keep live-turn prompts <400 tokens when possible. Provide template snippets for truncation + summary-first prompts.
- Runtime knobs: enable streaming, smaller model for interactive turns, larger model for batch summarization. Use prefix caching for repeated system context.
- Monitoring: enable per-route latency and token breakdown (Redwood Console) — flagged as helpful for troubleshooting.

Open items / ask from Redwood:
- Provide a short one-page perf tuning checklist + example SDK snippet to set region & timeout.
- Demo video: show regional test harness + streaming example.
- Clarify pricing delta between regions and any egress considerations.

Next steps (agreed):
- 2026-03-12: Ava to send perf checklist + SDK example and schedule 30m follow-up.
- 2026-03-16 week: Follow-up call to run live regional A/B test and review console traces.
- Customer to run reduced prompt experiment and report p95 improvements.

Notes style: shorthand, action-oriented. Record created from AE notes and SE repro attachments.
